name: Search visits grow
ownerWords:
not bad, but our DR is probably shit, we aint getting any visitors. can you have a meta-level goal and subgoals?

our goal is 10,000 blog/tool visits/day, and 300 sign ups from that. 

so you manage Search keyword research, competitor SEO analysis, like posting things on reddit, marketing forums ... to boost our DR, managing analytics and conversion realted to the initial land somewhere -> landing page/product page -> sign up or book a call flow
goal: Blog and tool visits on virev.ai, Google clicks and sign-ups whose first page was blog or tools climb toward the owner's 10,000 visits a day and 300 sign-ups a day (his t9 answer), and the numbers are read fresh every day. The visits targets will miss for months, so the job reads the distance and the trend. Raise google_clicks_d7 to 500 on 11-01, as program/brief.md says.

No Reddit or forum post, email or ticket reply without his ok on a For you todo (c37), no merge without his go (c49), and ask before a prod promote (staging lands are fine, c50). Send the owner one short status with clicks, visits, sign-ups and what shipped. Do this on every run, met or missed.
